cody_customer: Hey team — hitting a 413 on /v1/rerank when we pass ~120 docs + a long query. Response just says "payload too large". Any guidance? We need to keep docs whole.

alex_support: Hi @cody_customer — sorry about the hit. Can you paste the exact error response body and an anonymized curl we can run?

cody_customer: response: {\"error\":\"request payload too large\",\"code\":413}

curl snippet: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"query":"<big text>","documents":["... repeated 120 payloads ..."]}'```

alex_support: Thanks. We're seeing 'payload too large' which is generic. Our rerank endpoint enforces both token and document-count ceilings. For this workspace the limits are: 1) max total tokens per request ~120k tokens, 2) max documents per request 100. I'll ask eng to confirm actual numbers for your org.

mia_engineer: @alex_support FYI repro steps: I can reproduce locally by sending 120 docs of ~2k chars each + 4k char query. Tokenizer shows ~130k tokens. We return 413 when tokenized_bytes > limit before model scoring. Logs: `rerank.input.size_exceeded` with fields `token_count` and `doc_count`.

alex_support: Copy. @cody_customer quick ask: can you run this local check to measure token counts? ```python
from tiktoken import encoding_for_model
enc = encoding_for_model('redwood-rerank-1')
print(sum(len(enc.encode(d)) for d in documents) + len(enc.encode(query)))
``` Replace model accordingly.

cody_customer: I'll try. But is there an internal limit per-document size too? We got some docs with 50k chars.

mia_engineer: Yes — we enforce a per-document token ceiling (~10k tokens) to avoid catastrophic memory usage. If a single doc exceeds that we reject. Best workaround: split long docs into passages and send fewer passages per request, or use the 'passages' array field which we will accept with smaller chunks.

alex_support: If you want, we can patch your account to increase doc_count threshold temporarily while we discuss long-term solution. Also we'll change the error body to be more explicit with fields: `{\"error\":\"payload too large\",\"reason\":\"token_limit_exceeded\",\"token_count\":130234,\"token_limit\":120000}` — filing ticket now.

jon_oncall: :thumbsup: I'll file RFC to make 413 responses include both token_count and doc_count and a short how-to link. @mia_engineer please add telemetry key `token_count` to the rerank logs.

cody_customer: Thanks. One more: any sample chunking code? Prefer JS.

mia_engineer: Quick JS example: ```js
const enc = require('tiktoken').encoding_for_model('redwood-rerank-1')
function chunkText(t, maxTokens){
  const tok = enc.encode(t)
  if(tok.length<=maxTokens) return [t]
  // naive split by sentences
  const parts = t.match(/[^.?!]+[.?!]/g) || [t]
  const out=[]
  let cur=''
  for(const p of parts){
    if(enc.encode(cur+p).length>maxTokens){out.push(cur); cur=p;} else {cur+=p}
  }
  if(cur) out.push(cur)
  return out
}
```

cody_customer: Perfect. I'll run tokenizer and refactor. Appreciate the fast turnaround :pray: 

alex_support: Closing loop when you confirm it's working. Filing support ticket SUP-8853 for the error messaging change.
